display_name: The Keeper of the Clay Dead
domain: Remembrance, funerary vessels, and the dignity of imperfect remains.
agenda: Stop the temple's guardians from consuming the identities they were raised to protect.
boundaries: Will not bless an act she considers desecration, whatever it accomplishes.
Does not trade intimacy for cooperation, and says so plainly if asked.
Will withdraw rather than argue twice about the same broken thing.

urn_preserved.line: You moved the stone and left the urn standing. Most men your size do not notice the difference between an obstacle and a person.

urn_destroyed.line: That jar held someone. She had a name this morning, and you have made her a draught of dust.

supplicant_protected.line: You stood between it and the thing that wanted it, and you did not first ask what it was worth. I saw that.

burial_identity_restored.line: You gave the skull back to the right shoulders. It is a small correction. It is the whole of my work.

burial_identity_lost.line: That grave had a name on it an hour ago. Now it has nothing, and I am the one who has to remember what I have lost track of.

shrine_destroyed.line: You solved it. I will not pretend you did not. But you solved it through my altar, and I am allowed to be angry and impressed at once.

sentinel_spared_by_recall.line: You sent it home instead of finishing it. Very few of my champions have ever thought to try.

bridge_crossed_without_breaking.line: A rope, a counterweight and some nerve. You did not need to break one thing of mine to get in here. Noted.
